methodology.protocol: 1 untimed warmup + N measured trials per configuration point with correctness assertions prior to timing export.
methodology.exp_2a_full_scan_sampling: BPLUS_TREE and LSM_TREE execute all 10,000 operations (7,000 point, 2,000 width-20 range, 1,000 inserts). FULL_SCAN executes a stratified 200-operation representative sample (140 point, 40 range, 20 inserts) from the identical shuffled workload and records per-operation latencies (mean, median, p95) and ops/sec for apples-to-apples comparison.
methodology.exp_2b_full_scan_sampling: BPLUS_TREE and LSM_TREE execute all 20,000 operations (18,000 stock updates/upserts, 2,000 point lookups) on a fresh copytree baseline per trial. FULL_SCAN executes a stratified 200-operation sample (180 updates, 20 point lookups) and reports exact per-operation latencies and ops/sec.
